description:
List independent Polymarket quotes from the static pair directory, in
    market-id order. Optional family and side filters apply to that directory.
    Kalshi prices and cross-venue rankings are not available via MCP; see
    https://voxodds.com/polymarket-vs-kalshi for human comparisons.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

family.description: Optional market family key returned by this tool, e.g. 'democratic_nominee_2028'
family.title: Family

side.description: Optional 'Yes' or 'No' to restrict the side
side.title: Side

name: list_executable_opportunities
